ranch: Rancho Santa Margarita y Las Flores
county: San Diego County, California (Camp Pendleton / San Onofre / Oceanside). NOT the Orange County city of Rancho Santa Margarita.
notes_on_disambiguation: Several distinct ranchos share the 'Santa Margarita' name and were actively excluded: (1) Rancho Santa Margarita in San Luis Obispo County (Bancroft land case 149 SD, map B-1160; Walker 'Corral' ca.1885); (2) Rancho San Pedro, Santa Margarita y Las Gallinas in Marin County (Northern District land cases 10/16 ND); (3) the modern Orange County city Rancho Santa Margarita (Calisphere items 'Beach Club 1987', 'Habitat for Humanity 1990'). Also excluded: Rancho Monserratta sheep-ranching barn (Fallbrook, a neighboring but different rancho).

Holds docent materials and site photography (see newsletter CPHS vol.6 no.2). Physical museum on MCB Camp Pendleton; access requires base coordination.

San Diego History Center (Balboa Park, San Diego) — Photograph Collections index (https://sandiegohistory.org/collection/photographs/clist/) lists photographs of Marcos Forster's Rancho Santa Margarita y Las Flores. Research library and print/negative archive; many items not digitized. Contact via sandiegohistory.org. See also SDHC Journal Jul 1961 'Las Flores'.

USC Libraries Special Collections (Doheny Memorial Library) — specol@usc.edu — holds the original California Historical Society / Title Insurance and Trust and C.C. Pierce Photography Collection glass negatives and prints from which the USC digital items above derive; higher-resolution masters and additional un-digitized frames may be requestable.
